batch.note: The exact file copied from the miner object at the turn (before the batch-cap trim).

candidate.note: GREEN candidates become the next head; RED candidates are discarded but their hashes are listed here.

evaluated.estimator: per-env Hajek (inverse-probability ratio) estimate of Delta = sum_e share_e * mean_e(p_cand - p_head); SE = sqrt(sampling + rollout variance + run term max(tau^2 * 2 * A^2, sigma_run_floor^2))

dispatch.source: lifecycle TRAIN-DISPATCH-FF (signed): one document per prompt group, rewards as given

engine.status: unavailable: local trainer host config does not match the operator config hash in use

epoch_metrics.pg_clipfrac_note: actor-as-OLD with one PPO epoch: ratio == 1 exactly, so PPO clipping never binds

support_renorm.rule: sampled tokens outside the replayed top_k -> top_p support are dropped from the PG token mean only (still in KL and derail); files are never rejected for it

train_params.rule: kl replaces kl_coefficient in L = loss_scale * (1/N) * sum_i (1/K_i) * sum_t [pg + kl * k3]; lr: m = lr / sgd_lr, n_t = min(m * r_t * ||d_t||, sgd_tensor_rel_cap * (1 - 1e-6) * ||M_H,t||), s = min(1, sgd_update_norm_cap / ||n||), Delta_t = s * n_t * g_t / ||g_t||; m = 1 -> the v8.3.3i step exactly; step_mult k (v8.3.3k): n_t := k * n_t before the global cap (lr and per-tensor cap scaled together), k = 1 -> unchanged; knobs (v8.3.3l): see the TURN comment / mining.json batch_file.train; all default -> unchanged
